title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: Research revision of the four-dimensional sphere packing manuscript. A pair and triple cap comparison and a rational enumeration of radial profiles yield a packing-density bound below 0.634625. Some 24–27-neighbour cases of the sharp volume bound remain open.
